title: Negative: witness sketches of black smoke burst twisting into 1-2 mile streak
description: Negative photostat of a typed account of a small black cloud that stretched into a wide, twisting streak and moved west against the wind before vanishing. Below an "Agent's Note" are sketches labeled "1st position" (a small cloud), a horizontal streak with direction arrow captioned "width same - length estimated at 1 to 2 miles", and a curled streak captioned "Streak twisted and turned - suddenly disappeared". A small north arrow appears at right, and the page has struck-through CONFIDENTIAL stamps.
